PR: fix(validate): digest handling and defaults from xrds/crds [closed]
### Description of your changes
This PR adds default value application to schema validation by implementing `applyDefaults` and `applyDefaultsToObject` functions that recursively apply default values from structural schemas to unstructured resources before validation occurs. It also fixes image reference handling by properly parsing container image references to extract repository names and supporting both digest and tag formats for dependencies.
